delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.description: This stops the database and removes it from Levelrail. Its data volume and backups in your storage destination are kept, so the data can still be recovered by an operator. Apps that connect to it will lose the connection.
delete.inUseDescription: Delete anyway only if you have already moved or detached these apps.

version.title: Change version of "{{name}}"
version.description: Minor and patch updates recreate the container over the same data. A major version change needs the guarded major upgrade (Postgres) below, or a backup restored into a new database. Take a backup first.
version.label: Version
version.toast: Database "{{name}}" will be recreated on version {{version}}.
version.pgvectorHint: A pgvector database uses a version like "17-pgvector". Switching between plain and pgvector in place is refused: use the guarded major upgrade below, or restore a backup into a new database.

existingVolume.title: A deleted database with this name left its data behind
existingVolume.description: Choose what to do with the old data volume ({{size}}). Reusing it brings the old data back; discarding it deletes it permanently and starts empty.

walShip.label: WAL copy in bucket
walShip.hint: Archived WAL is copied to the backup target so point-in-time restore survives losing this host's disk.

majorUpgrade.title: Major version upgrade
majorUpgrade.description: Upgrades this database across a major version by dump and restore. It is offline while it runs. The old data is copied to a rollback snapshot first, and a failure after that rolls back automatically.
majorUpgrade.confirmLabel: Type the database name to confirm
majorUpgrade.rollbackConfirm: Roll back to version {{version}}? Every write since the upgrade is lost.
majorUpgrade.discardConfirm: Delete the rollback snapshot? You can no longer roll back this upgrade.
majorUpgrade.pitrBlocked: Disable point-in-time restore before upgrading: its base backups cannot be replayed on another major version.
majorUpgrade.pgvectorHint: Use a version like "17-pgvector" to move a plain database onto the pgvector image. Moving back to plain Postgres is not supported.

viewer.unsupported: The viewer supports Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, and Redis-compatible engines. This database is {{engine}}.
viewer.notRunning: The viewer needs a running database. Start the database and try again.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.empty: No user tables yet. Create a table and it will show up here.
explorer.selectTable: Select a table to browse its data, columns, and indexes.
explorer.truncated: Showing the first {{count}} tables only. Narrow the search or raise the server limit.

data.filterHint: Type in a column filter row to narrow rows in the database. Prefix with = for an exact match, or use is:null and not:null.
data.limitsNote: Rows load {{page}} at a time. The server returns at most {{rows}} rows per request, cuts any value at {{cell}}, and stops a query after {{seconds}} seconds.

grid.resultCapped: Result capped by the server row or size limit.
grid.cellCapped: This value was cut at the server cell size limit.
grid.label: Table rows
grid.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
grid.headerHint: Click to sort. Drag to reorder, or press Alt with the arrow keys.

console.title: SQL Console
console.explainHint: Explain analyze executes the statement (read-only) to report real timings.
console.shortcut: Run with Ctrl or Cmd plus Enter
console.writeToggleHint: Admin only. Runs one statement in a committed transaction and is recorded in the audit log.
console.writeConfirmDescription: Statements run in this console will change data in "{{name}}" and are committed immediately. Each one is recorded in the audit log. Type the database name to continue.
console.noResultsYet: Run a statement to see results here.
console.okNoRows: Statement ran. It returned no rows.

history.empty: Your recent statements for this database show up here.

saved.empty: Save a statement to reuse it later.

keys.title: Key browser
keys.selectKey: Select a key to see its value.
keys.truncated: Value cut at the server limit.
keys.readOnlyNote: Read-only. Values are fetched with SCAN, TYPE, TTL, and a type-specific read.

structure.noRelations: This table has no foreign keys and nothing references it.

states.loading: Reading the schema from the database...
states.errorNote: Nothing here means your data is gone. The explorer simply could not read it right now.

reason.permission: The database refused the read: permission denied for the account the explorer uses.
reason.connection: The database is not accepting connections yet, or refused this one.
reason.timeout: The database took too long to answer and the read timed out.
reason.notRunning: The database is not running. Start it and retry.
reason.helper: The helper that runs inside the database container failed before it could return a schema.
reason.network: The browser could not reach the control plane.
reason.unsupported: This control plane cannot run commands inside database containers.

states.emptyVerifyTitle: No tables found, check this against the evidence below
states.emptyBody: This database was checked and has no user tables. Create tables from the SQL console, or point an app at it.
states.migrationTarget: This database was created as a migration target.
states.copyCli: or run: migrate db-copy <database> with the CLI.
states.verifiedEmpty: The copy is marked verified but the database has no tables. A verified copy should never be empty, so treat this as an error and run the copy again.
states.contradiction_one: The catalog reports {{count}} table but the listing returned none. Retry, and if this persists check the helper logs.
states.contradiction_other: The catalog reports {{count}} tables but the listing returned none. Retry, and if this persists check the helper logs.

evidence.tables: Tables and views in those schemas
evidence.unavailable: The catalog counts could not be read, so this emptiness is not verified.

states.noMatchesNote: The database has tables. Only your search filtered them out.

createPgvector.label: Include pgvector
createPgvector.hint: Runs the pgvector image so CREATE EXTENSION vector works. The version is stored as {{version}}.
